initialExam.title: UP Police Constable 2026
initialExam.description: Uttar Pradesh Police Constable recruitment for 32,679 posts. Written exam completed 8-10 Jun 2026; provisional answer key released 20 Jun 2026. Result expected Jul 2026.
initialExam.syllabus: General Hindi, General Knowledge, Numerical & Mental Ability, Reasoning.
initialExam.examPattern: Written: 150 questions, 300 marks, 2 hours. PET/PST mandatory.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Exam → PET/PST → Document Verification → Medical
initialExam.jobRole: Constable Civil Police & PAC in UP Police
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit uppbpb.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Uniform Allowance, Medical, Pension
